safetyAndCompliance.name: Test results and compliance
safetyAndCompliance.text: This cover’s ability to resist abrasion has been tested to handle 40,000 cycles. 15,000 cycles or more is suitable for furniture used every day at home. Over 30,000 cycles means a good ability to resist abrasion.

safetyAndCompliance.name: Test results and compliance
safetyAndCompliance.text: The cover has a lightfastness level of 5-6 (the ability to resist color fading) on a scale of 1 to 8. According to industry standards, a lightfastness level of 4 or higher is suitable for home use.

safetyAndCompliance.name: Test results and compliance
safetyAndCompliance.text: This seating furniture is tested and complies with relevant strength and durability standards. The tests simulate typical usage of the product and are based on use by persons weighing up to 242 lbs.

paragraphs: A sofa with small dimensions, which is easy to furnish with, even when space is limited.
The design allows us to use the material more efficiently in production, which is good for the planet – and helps us give you a lower price.
The slightly angled legs make the sofa stable, while giving it a personal expression.
The sofa's low weight makes it easy to move – in your current home or when moving to a new home.
This cover is made from Knisa fabric in polyester, which is dope-dyed. It’s a durable material which has a soft feel.
10 year Limited warranty. Read about the terms in the warranty brochure.

reviews.text: The pillows do not fit at all. I was given three pillows that were each 1.5 times the size of the supposed size so I cannot fit the pillows into the case and they are just left outside. The parts are also not manufactured well so they do not fit together out of the box, you need to make adjustments to get the parts together.
